batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b M Morkel

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b M Morkel

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b AC Thomas

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c JD Ryder b SC Ganguly

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b AC Thomas

batting.name: Y Nagar
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b AC Thomas

balls.text: yorker length, he digs it out to long-off, and they take a couple of runs to finish the innings.
full-toss and that has been smacked away to the cover region for another four, expensive bowling from Morkel.
bowled him! Ryder's middle pole has been pegged back and Morkel has his third. On the stumps, and Ryder wanted to go over the top, missed and he is bowled.
yorker length, outside the off-stump and that is dug out, to point for a single
full-toss and that has been spanked away to the fine-leg region for a four, there was a short fine-leg in place and he watched it away.
pitched full, outside the off stump and that is drilled away to the off-side for a single
strange shot, Smith wanted to lap it over third-man, misses completely.
Ryder was giving himself room to play over the short fine-leg, Yadav saw it, bowled it wide and it hits him on his pads, single

slower one, he waited for it, and he waited more and then slammed it over mid-wicket for a six. He is picking them really well and that has landed in the crowds yet again! This is ballooning up to be a big one...
short, a quick bouncer, pulled to long-on and they come back for the second, 142.7 km/hr
138.3 km/hr and fullish, he misses it again!
outside the off-stump, wanted to hit over the in-field, missed.
goes down the pitch yet again and that has been thwacked over the straight boundary, excellent batting for the Sydney Sixers captain!
full-toss and reverse swept over the fine-leg region for a one-bounce four
driven that full delivery back to the bowler, who misfields and they take a single
shorter this time, slower as well and he has pulled it to the leg-side for a single
short ball and that has been smacked over the mid-wicket region for a six! Excellent batting from Smith yet again towards the end of the innings.
gives himself room by moving outside the leg-stump and hits him over the bowler for a four.
down the leg-side and the sweep shot is missed, but that is a wide.
paddled it over the short fine-leg and Ryder has got a four! He was moving before the ball was bowled and scooped it over...moves to 75. 12 off the over.
another swing, quicker one, missed it completely.
slower ball and that is gone! Gone over the deep square-leg region for a six! Ryder saw the slower one early enough, moves to his highest T20 score.
length ball, drifting down the leg-side, tries to hit it over the leg-side, misses, hits pads and they are off for a single, leg-bye.
full-toss outside the off-stump and this is spanked away to the extra-cover region, Ryder gave up the ghost and had that hit the non-striker's end, would have been curtains.
outside the off-stump, very full, and Ryder misses it, goes through to the wicket-keeper.
slower one, Ryder goes for a pull and they take a single. 11 from the over.
pitched right up to the bat and Ryder has squeezed it through to long-on where Jayawardene slides, stops, and throws it to Morkel, well fielded.
pitched up to the bat, slower one, lofted over the in-field and seems to have gone for four at wide long-off. Morkel did well to get there, but wasn't able to stop it.
slower one, shorter as well, dabbed away to the leg-side, they took one and then waned a second one, a better throw from fine-leg could have seen him out.
slower one outside the off-stump and he goes for the drive, gets an inside-edge for a single
short ball and he has been spanked to deep square-leg for a four. So seven off the over but a wicket too.
pitched right up and he has driven it to the long-on for a single
some bounce this time, Ryder was trying to run it down to third-man, but beaten by the bounce.
pitched right up to the batsman, defends on the back-foot and they are off for a single

that was smacked off the middle of the bat and for most part of its journey, it looked like it was well-hit. It was, no doubt, but went straight to the fielder at long-on.Yadav juggled around a little after he caught it, but managed to hold on in the end.
outside the off-stump, fullish in length, driven to long-on for a single.
Ganguly wanted to scoop it over the short fine-leg, Pathan sees it, bowls it wider outside the off-stump and slower, he misses it.
bouncer and surprised Ganguly, but it was a high bouncer, called a wide.
full-toss, slipped from his hand after the bowler had slipped while completing his run-up, hit to mid-off.
full pitched yet again and that has been dug out to the off-side for a single.
length ball, played away to the long-on fielder for a single
yorker length ball, not exactly your definition of a toe-crusher but does its job of restricting the batsman.
short and not much pace, pulled away and fortunately for him, goes straight to hand.
shortish, and Ryder plays it to the leg-side for a single.
tries to sweep it, misses and a wide called.
short ball and that is pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a four. There was a fielder, almost 5 yards away, but he did not get close.
on his pads, and flicked away to the leg-side for a single
goes for a sweep, misses, it was on length.
outside the off-stump, short and punched to long-on for a single
drives to long-off and gets a half-century off only 33 balls.

smashed him! It has not been a great day for Rauf, who has almost been cleaned up, Ganguly smacked it back to the bowler, who missed it and the umpire went down for the count. Signalled boundary from the ground too!
and Ryder has half-pulled, half-swept it to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
tries to play it to the leg-side, hits the pad, was pitched up to him.
dropped! Yogesh Nagar and Mahela Jayawardene were both going for the catch and in the end, nobody went for it! Ganguly survives that lofted attempt...
that has been swept, over the short fine-leg fielder for a four. He moved to the off-side, went inside the line and popped it over the short fine-leg fielder.
outside the leg-stump, goes down the track and nudges it to the deep square for a single
goes for a flashy drive yet again, he is moving a lot in his crease, misses it and Naman Ojha has another one thudding into his gloves.
shorter from Yadab, quicker as well, 142.4 km/hr, he went for the pull but hits his pads.
pitched slightly up, goes for a drive by moving towards the leg-side but gets it only to extra-cover for a single
outside the off-stump and Ganguly tries to dab it away to the third-man, misses it.
slower one, played it away to the long-on for a single
outside the off-stump, goes for a flashy stroke outside the off-stump, missed.
again outside the leg-stump and played away softly to short mid-wicket.
very short from Nadeem and Ryder pulls it away for a single
this time on the middle-stump and that is nudged away to short fine-leg for a single
he is bowling around the wicket, pitching them outside the leg-stump and he has played it away to the leg-side.
again on the pads, flicked it away for a single
another one down the leg-side, and this time the keeper and the bowler appeal hard, umpire thinks and then gives it a wide.
outside the leg-stump, going straight and wide down the leg-side
keeps low, tries to on-drive it but goes to the short mid-wicket fielder.
short ball, cut away to the deep cover for a single and they will take a Time-Out. Not a bad time for it, Pune are racing away in the same manner as the Chargers were in the previous game.
down the leg-side, and a wide called. Seemed to have hit something on the way.
another one down the leg-side and it is another wide.
pushed to mid-off where the extra-cover fielder runs and fields.
and now he plays it to the leg-side for a single
gone all the way for a six! Ganguly has managed to connect off the middle of the bat and it was almost caught! That is a drop, pushed over the long-off fence for a six.
down the leg-side and that is very wide. He went for a sweep but missed.
played away to the leg-side for a single
inside-out and Ryder has caressed it over extra-cover for a four!
swept and very fine, the fine-leg was inside the circle and he ends the over the way Ryder had started it.
tries to go for a sweep, hits the pads and goes to the wicket-keeper.
flicked away to the leg-side for a single
on his pads yet again and this time the attempted sweep goes nowhere.
driven back to the bowler.
swept away, and for a four! It was on his pads and he did not waste this opportunity.
driven to the long-off for a single
goes down the pitch and defends back.
swept away and whoa, it has hit the umpire, Asad Rauf flush on his hands. Wake-up call, says Rameez on air, for Asad!
dabbed it to the off-side and Ganguly wanted a single, Ryder did not, before he went for it as well. Confusion leads to nothing...
hits inside out, or at least attempts it anyway, but only a single
drives to long-off for a single
yorker length, Ganguly digs it out well and they rush off for a single to mid-on.
driven to mid-on for a single. 30 runs conceded by Morkel already!
good length ball and Ryder has spanked it over mid-wicket for a four. That was a bit of a thick inside edge and that is 29 runs conceded off 10 balls from Morkel!
tries to upper cut it over third-man but the timing does not come to him and a couple.
that has been hit over the mid-off, almost over, Pietersen dived all the way and got his hands to it, popped over for a four and it is a no-ball as well!
yorker length, and almost sneaks through, gets the bat in at the last fraction and squeezes through the point for a single. There was a second run there but with Ryder and Ganguly running...
he does get a boundary at last, and will you be surprised if I said it is off an edge yet again! makes room, finds the outside edge, goes over the cordon!
short ball from Umesh Yadav and what Ganguly was trying this entire over, Ryder succeeds, gets a top-edge over the keeper's head for a six! Second six off an edge!
finally the slash gets some bat on it and it goes straight to the third-man fielder for a single
shorter this time and it beats Ganguly yet again! Wanted to slash it away but missed.
outside the off-stump, goes for a full-bloodied drive, it was fullish too, but misses.
pitched right up and driven but not timed, goes to the fielder.
Short from Yadav and tries to pull away, but does not get an under edge through to the keeper.
short ball and dabbed away to the third-man region for a single
gone, edged and taken by the wicket-keeper! Uthappa had edged once earlier off Pathan for four, this time, he tried to cut it away but only got an outside edge through to the keeper.
pitched right up to the bat and Uthappa drives it down the ground for a single
down the leg-side and left alone, wide called. Already 12 runs off the Purple Cap holder's first over.
almost goes back and pushes it to the covers for a single
coming into the batsman and this time it is inside-edged for a four! Fortunate couple of shots for Ryder!
that has been edged away for a six! Yep, he wanted to go over the straight boundary, a thick outside edge and that has gone to the third-man fence for a six!
good length ball, wanted to go for a slog and ended up playing to wide mid-on where KP fields again and Ryder gets a single
driven straight to KP at mid-off for a single.
edged away and four over the slips! Good ball this, pulled up the length, swinging away from Pathan and he went for a drive and takes the outside edge
finally, hit very well through the extra cover region for a four! That was pitched right up to the batsman and stuck well.
pitched right up to the bat and jagging in, tried to flick it away but misses, hits pads, big appeal and that is negated.
coming into the left-hander and that is played away to mid-on, for the seventh successive dot for Pathan.
outside the leg stump, flicked away to the leg-side for a single
driven straight to the mid-on fielder, Pietersen, who was also miked up with the commentators.
comes into the batsman this time and he tries to cut away, straight to the fielder
on his pads from around the wicket, flicked away for the first run of the game. Off the ninth ball.
outside the off stump and driven to the mid-off region.
driven down back to the bowler
pitched up, drilled to the off-side but goes straight to the covers and that is Pathan's seventh maiden over in the history of IPL cricket!
swinging in from length and he goes on the front-foot, covers the swing and plays it to the leg-side, he wants a single again.
another one outside the off-stump and he tries to late-cut to third-man, beaten!
outside the off-stump, deviating slightly into the batsman and he dabs it to the off-side, wanted a single but sent back.
and again, outside the off-stump, good length and Uthappa has nothing to do with it. Leaves it alone
outside the off-stump, good length and Uthappa has left it alone.
full-toss, and that has been hit away to deep mid-wicket for a single, end of the game, Pune has made it four wins to level with Delhi, Chennai and Rajasthan on eight points!
shot, drilled back to the bowler, was pitched right up and he takes a single
yorker length, played straight back to long-on for a single
bouncer, wanted to pull it away and hit flush on the helmet. Lovely!
full ball, almost a yorker, and he has flicked it away to wide long-on for a couple. They need a Gayle on strike.
pitched up and lifted to extra-cover, straight to Ganguly fielding there, simple catch made to look as easy.
finally a connection, finally a six, finally some hope! That was pitched right up to the bat, was slower and he went for the shot, that has gone over the bowler's head!
shorter this time and he has been pulled, but no timing whatsoever, single to long-on.
pitched right up to the bat, driven to long-off for a single.
slower one, outside the leg-stump, played away to the leg-side for a single.
another full-toss from Nehra, outside the off-stump, hit over extra-cover but only for a couple.
full-toss and that has been smashed through the extra-cover region for a four.
a very full ball, angling in, cramping him for room, driven to long-on for a single.
shorter, slower this time and he waited for the ball to present itself to the bat, slashed over Kartik at point and that has gone to the point fence.
quicker, shorter and the batsman fails to get anywhere close to the ball.
pitched up to the bat and the batsman has gone for a shot over extra-cover, it gets an outside edge instead, and the third-man is nowhere near...
short ball and Taylor has pulled it straight to the long-on fielder, Smith. Slower ball too and that meant that Taylor needed to make all the power on the ball. End of the Kiwi.
pitched right up to the bat, squeezed through to long-on for a single
flicked away, pitched right up to the bat and the batsman gets a chunky part of the bat to it, but goes straight to the fielder at deep square-leg.
short and went for a pull, misses the shot and the umpire has not called it a wide! Did it come off the glove, don't think so...
outside the off-stump and tries to go for a slash, misses.
pitched up to the bat and outside the leg-stump, Taylor isn't getting too much room to play any shot and it hits the pads, gets a leg-bye
pitched outside, on his pads, short of length and that has been pulled, or at least attempted anyway, gets not too much bat on it and there is a single.
shorter, slower and the batsman tries to nudge it to leg-side, gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
on the pads and that has been flicked over the short fine-leg fielder for a four, 54 needed from four overs.
big, big appeal, Ganguly was almost pestering the umpire, who almost told the captain to calm down! Tried to go for a slog there...
played away to the long-off for a single.
shorter one, and he goes for a pull, played to deep square-leg for a single.
short of a length, played away to the leg-side for a single
on the off-stump, dabbed away to long-on for a single
tried to sweep it away, does not get too much of a bat, only a single
pitched right up, shaping to sweep it away but quicker on to him.
played away to the leg-side again for a single...
driven to mid-wicket for another single
on the off-stump, played away to the leg-side for a single.
outside the off-stump, pitched right up to the bat and goes for a single.
down the leg-side, quicker one and that is called a wide.

gone, run-out! nudged away to the leg-side and takes a single, and then suddenly out of nowhere, Negi wanted to go for the second. Taylor did not take off and both were stranded at the same end. Run-out at the striker's end.
dropped! And that is Mathews again, how do you drop a catch off the bowling of your captain! It was slashed again and it went high and straight to Mathews, who floors it!
tries to spank it over long-on, instead he slashes it and it goes high in the air, Mathews had to run back from short extra-cover and fails to get under it.
driven to the extra-cover region, hit in the air and it falls just short.
outside the off-stump, defended in a manner to make Dravid proud.
pitched right up, driven to long-off for a single
outside the off-stump and driven back to the bowler, end of a successful over.
pitched right up to the batsman and it has been swept over the extra-cover fielder and that is gone for a four!
quicker one, tapped to long-on for a single
gone, caught! Sehwag is gone, two wickets in two overs as Kartik has dismissed Sehwag! Pitched up and Sehwag drills it back to the bowler, who catches it really well off his own bowling.
sweeps it away to a ball from around the wicket.
spinning into the batsman, played away to he leg-side and a dot.
gone, caught! Goes down the pitch and Pathan seems to have timed it well enough, but it goes to the fielder at deep mid-wicket and that is well caught!
he is trying to cramp Sehwag by bowling on to his pads but he is able to flick it away for a single
nudged away to the leg-side for a single
pitched on Sehwag's legs, he belts it to the deep square-leg fielder, gets him on the bounce.
pitched up, outside the off-stump and that is hit to long-on for a single
Shot! it was on his pads and Pathan hoicks it over the mid-wicket region for a six. Cleanly lifted and deposited!
on his pads, driven to the long-on region for a single
that is cut away and it almost races away to the fence, but Thomas dives at deep point, cuts it down for only a single
outside the off-stump from around the wicket and that has been edged away over the fine third-man for four.
on his pads and that is flicked away to the short fine-leg, only a single
outside the off-stump and he goes for a cut, misses. And surprise, surprise, given a wide.
outside the off-stump, nudged away to the off-side for a single.
outside the leg-stump, driven through to the deep square-leg for a single
outside the off-stump, pitched up and driven down to long-off for a single.
pitched up and driven through the covers for a single. Sehwag gets to a 50 off 27 balls.
loud, loud appeal, it looked like it was pitching outside the leg-stump and Ganguly has had some words with the umpire. He is breathing fire.
on the leg-side and played away to long-on for a single.
driven to the long-off for a single

pegged back, the stump is pegged back! Ganguly has conjured up some magic and sent the stumps back, and then he has also gone for the run towards some place in the ground! First ball in the IPL since 2010, and he has a wicket!
goes down the pitch and Sehwag has blasted the ball out of the ground. Well that is only figuratively speaking but it really went high and long and Delhi have made a rousing start to their chase.
goes down the track yet again and this time it is shorter, cut away to short fine-leg.
goes down the pitch, gets it on the full-toss and he places that brilliantly between long-on and mid-wicket.
driven through to long-off for a single
he wanted to play a lot of shots there, first a paddle, then a drive, finally played the cut for a single. Moved a lot in the crease.
plays it away to the mid-wicket for a single
another six, another one pitched up to the batsman and Sehwag isn't going to stop playing strokes when in this mood and when faced with this target...that has gone over the covers for a flat six.
pitched up and Sehwag was waiting for that one, he has smashed that over the covers for a six!
played away to the short fine-leg for a single
shortish and deviating a little away, KP wanted to cut it, misses and Uthappa also does not collect cleanly.
pitched further up and driven down to long-off for a single
slashed away for a four! Short and cut away, one bounce to the point fence.
full-toss from Sharma and Sehwag has smacked it back to the long-off region for a single. Sehwag wasn't too happy with the stroke, wanted to get more value...
short of length, outside the off-stump, cut away for a single
down the pitch and KP has smacked it back to the bowler, who fails to get down in time to field and that has gone to the fence as well
quicker, skidding on, keeps a tad low, tried to cut it and it goes straight to the covers.
comes down the track, shortening of the length and it is pushed to the long-off fielder for a single
shorter one from Sharma, tried to whips it to the leg-side, inside-edge on to the pads.
three in the over, second match in a row that he has smacked three sixes in an over, this time it was spanked over the long-on region for a six! Delhi are away!
pitched slightly up to the bat and this time Pietersen drives him over the in-field and it carries!
short ball, bouncer, and that looked to have gone over KP yet again, but not called a wide.
how do you play that shot? That was a shorter ball, it was slower and Pietersen could have played it anywhere on the field, he chose to play it over the bowler's head for a six!
Sehwag was moving in his crease, wanted to play over the leg-side for a fraction but taps it away to the off-side for a single
outside the off-stump, driven on the up and it goes to wide mid-off for a single
goes down the track, the fourth such shot of the over in a row, and it has been played away to mid-wicket for a single
comes down yet again but this time it is outside off, pitched up and dabbed away for a single
goes down the track yet again, Kartik saw this, pitched it shorter and this time the cut has been sizzles through the covers.
finally, the shimmy and the six! Sehwag was not getting too many and he immediately went down the track and lofted him over the bowler.
slowed it down a little, on the legs, played away for a single
straighter one, goes on with the arm and KP defends on the back foot.

Sehwag was getting frustrated there, went for a cut through the covers, Steven Smith dived to his right, stopped a certain four, got up and Pandey threw it back to the wicket-keeper, Sehwag was way down the track and would have been run-out had he collected it. Instead the bails were whipped without the ball in his gloves.
slower this time and he tries to cut it away, straight to the cover fielder.

short ball from the Delhi boy and the other Delhi boy goes for a hook, misses and goes through to the keeper. Ryder, at this stage, was attempting similar shots and getting top-edges for fours and sixes!
pitched on the leg-stump, and KP plays him off his pads for a single
short of good length, coming into the batsman, played away to the leg-side.
again bowled within the stumps and Sehwag defends on his back-foot, played away to mid-on for a single
slower, shorter, and KP was looking to go for the pull, then looking at the change of pace, pulled out of the pull!
slower ball, KP waited and then defended yet again. Good start for Pune so far.
pitched right up and KP goes on to the back-foot and defends.
on the middle-stump, this time is is nudged away to the square-leg for a couple of runs.
that was shorter in length and Pietersen stood up tall, tried to flick it through the leg-side, goes straight to the short fine-leg.
gone, is it? Yes he is out! It was outside the off-stump, on the full, and he has knocked it straight to the fielder, a very soft dismissal this early!
on the off-stump and glided it to the third-man region for a single
drilled! Mahela had enough of defending, goes down the track and absolutely smashes it through the covers.
good length and Nehra is getting some bounce, almost squares Mahela, defended back to the bowler.
swinging into the batsman a tad and that is nudged away to the leg-side for a single
short of length and tapped away to the off-side, Sehwag wanted the run but he was really sluggish to get to the striker's end, had that hit, he was out. Smith misses.
on the off-stump, goes on the front-foot, dabbed away to the leg-side.
full-toss, hits the toe end of Sehwag's bat and it goes to the point fielder. End of a decent first over.
on to his pads and Sehwag was ready to whip it over the in-field on the leg-side, misses, hits the pad.
outside the off-stump, not too much width and that has been smashed over the covers for a four.
bouncer and that is evaded clumsily by Sehwag. He almost ducked into it.
short of length, bouncing a tad more than he expected, goes on the back-foot and defends.
on the middle, bit of movement away, played away to the leg-side for a single.
